rationale: itnet-claude-agentic: pretrain_epochs=120, pretrain_lr=0.001, itnet_k=5, itnet_alpha=0.1, unet_c=16, finetune_epochs=0, finetune_lr=0.0001, train_n=400, val_n=200, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, rationale=iter-2 (breast ItNet v1, search-20260703-01). SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR NUMBERS: iter-1 (pretrain_epochs=20) -> val_ssim 0.8237, hr 0.0000 (BELOW sparse-view FBP baseline), PSNR 25.63, RMSE 0.01786, elapsed 211.9s. Job clean (only benign CuDNN warn). (2) FAILURE MODE: under-baseline recon (hr=0) AND severe budget under-use (212s of a 1200s budget). The single trainable component is the SmallUNet denoiser (0.2329M), pretrained FBP->truth for only 20 epochs; likely UNDER-TRAINED. (3) ONE KNOB: pretrain_epochs 20 -> 120 (6x). All else identical to iter-1. (4) HYPOTHESIS: if I train the denoiser 6x longer, I expect hr to clear 0 (recon RMSE drops below the FBP baseline) and ssim to rise, because the denoiser was the only trainable lever and 20 epochs on 400 scenes is far from converged; a sibling ITNet v2 reached hr 0.826 and DD-supervised 0.81 on this same val=200, so the substrate clears baseline easily -> iter-1 was under-trained. FALSIFIER: if hr stays 0 at 120 epochs, the denoiser is NOT the bottleneck and the fixed k=5/alpha=0.1 DC unroll is re-injecting sparse-view streaks (raising RMSE) -> iter-3 pivots to the DC knobs (k, alpha). (5) BUDGET: 20ep=212s measured -> per-epoch ~ (212-fixed)/20; fixed cost (load+200-slice k=5 val+fig) dominates. Even at a conservative 6x train cost, 120 epochs predicts ~900s < 1200s budget. (6) Loop continues; iter-3 dispatched on landing via numeric-headroom gate.
